snippet.title: IShowSpeed calls his dad about Watkins Auto Parts in GTA 6 😭 "We finally made it"
snippet.description:
After spotting a "WATKINS AUTO PARTS" sign in GTA 6 Trailer 2 (his real name is Darren Watkins Jr.), IShowSpeed FaceTimed his dad live: "Dad, guess what? We are in GTA 6!" His dad had the backstory ready: "That's the old company... in 1950, when he got out of the Korean War, he invested his money into auto shop." 😭
🎥 Reaction: IShowSpeed (@IShowSpeed · Live Speedy) · footage: Rockstar Games, Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 2
